zones.name: Red Sea and Bab el-Mandeb
zones.note: Most cables between Europe and Asia pass here. Several were cut in 2024 when a ship hit by a missile dragged its anchor.

zones.name: Strait of Malacca
zones.note: Almost every cable between Singapore and South Asia, the Middle East or Europe follows the strait.

zones.name: Luzon Strait
zones.note: Earthquakes here cut several cables at once in 2006, slowing internet across East Asia for weeks.

zones.name: Taiwan Strait and Taiwan coast
zones.note: Cables to Taiwan and its outlying islands have been cut repeatedly; Matsu lost its links for weeks in 2023.

zones.name: Baltic Sea
zones.note: Several cables and pipelines were damaged by ships dragging anchors in 2023–2025, leading NATO to step up patrols.

zones.name: Strait of Hormuz and the Gulf
zones.note: Gulf states depend on a few cables through the strait, plus routes across Saudi Arabia.

zones.name: Black Sea
zones.note: Few cables, but the main sea route between the Caucasus and Europe.
